capabilities: Mark notes for bulk operations via a configurable checkbox property
Update a chosen property across all selected notes at once
Merge, replace, or delete values on multi-value properties (Aliases, List, Tags)
Delete selected notes after confirmation, honoring the vault's deleted-files preference
Show the number of selected notes in the status bar and run deselect commands
extras: README warns that large operations can make Obsidian's metadata cache take several minutes to re-index, leaving Bases and property views stale; the warning can be suppressed in settings. Not reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian edits note properties one note at a time, so applying the same property change to many notes is repetitive manual work.
summary: Bulk-edit or delete properties across multiple notes selected with a checkbox property, with merge, replace, and delete actions for multi-value properties.
